definitions.explanation: Recently made, obtained, or experienced; not stale, old, or spoiled.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{新鮮|しんせん}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{新鮮|しんせん}な⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{田舎|いなか}→田舎：01320_inaka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新鮮|しんせん}な⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{吸|す}って→吸う：04394_suu⟧⟦{気持|きも}ちよかった→気持ちよい：noentry⟧。
examples.english: Breathing the fresh country air felt good.

examples.english: When I first started living abroad, everything felt fresh and new.

notes:
{新鮮|しんせん} is used for both physical freshness (food, air) and abstract newness (ideas, experiences).

FORMS:
- {新鮮|しんせん}な + noun (fresh ~)
- {新鮮|しんせん}⟦さ→さ：noentry⟧ (freshness - noun form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新鮮|しんせん}な⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧ (fresh vegetables)
- {新鮮|しんせん}な⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧ (fresh air)
- {新鮮|しんせん}な⟦{気持|きも}ち→気持ち：01385_kimochi⟧ (fresh feeling)
- {新鮮|しんせん}な⟦{驚|おどろ}き→驚き：02562_odoroki⟧ (novel surprise)
- {新鮮|しんせん}⟦さ→さ：noentry⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保|たも}つ→保つ：10134_tamotsu⟧ (to maintain freshness)
